messages:
Devin: Huge thank you to Lina and Jordan for jumping on the midnight demo rescue. You two literally saved the presentation. :tada:
Lina: 😅 no problem — glad the hotfix landed. nice teamwork.
Jordan: Team effort! Shoutout to Mia for those quick test cases that caught the edge-case. @Mia
Mia: 😬 I only wrote two asserts but they had big feelings. coffee for everyone? ☕️
Ben: I'll bring a thermos of espresso tomorrow. Also @Asha moved the routing rule in 3 mins like a wizard. :mage:
Asha: heh, had to open the old runbook. putting it on wiki now -> https://wiki.redwood/demo-runbook (react:bookmark)
OpsBot: Deploy succeeded: canary -> production at 00:12 UTC (react:rocket)
Devin: Also big thanks to the on-call team for staying calm — we did it without waking up half the office. :smile:
Jordan: Can we make this a mini-retro tomorrow? 10 minutes, grab bagels on me. (react:thumbsup)
Lina: Love a quick retro. +1 for bagels. 🥯
Asha: Recording note: kudos thread for LinkedIn shoutout? marketing tag @marketing?
Ben: @marketing if you want a 1-liner: "Cross-team midnight rescue — product demo saved!" :clap:
Mia: Honestly felt like a band practicing for showtime. Great job everyone. (react:party)
Devin: Alright team — thanks again. Really appreciate the help. <3
